data_description_zh: 收錄各醫院申報2011-2017 年診斷個案以後之原始資料。
notes_zh:
1. ※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身
分證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日
期等欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜
出經審核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。
2. 收錄各醫院申報 2011-2017 年診斷個案以後之原始資料，並未進行院際間相同個
案同一癌症同一組織型態分組之重複個案去除。
3. 癌症登記短表(100年版)所包含之癌症別，除短表醫院申報的所有癌症外，還包含
長表醫院申報之外其他所有癌別，均以短表申報。
4. 個案分類為0或3者，不需申報欄位序號7.1-7.5，以9補滿。
5. 如需分析自1979年診斷至最新發表年度，且已去除院際重複之年報歸戶資料，請
申請年報歸戶檔。
primary_keys_raw:
1. 身分證字號(ID)經加密處理。
2. 個人歸戶及個人資料對照的鍵值：ID。

fields.description_zh:
經加密處理。
身分證字號或外籍居留證號碼(如無居留證號碼為護照號碼)。
9999999999：個案無身分證統一編號。
fields.description_en: Encrypted. National ID number or foreigner residence permit number (if no residence permit number, please fill in passport number). 9999999999 : case has no national ID number.

fields.description_zh:
1：男性
2：女性
3：其他(如雙性人，hermaphrodite)
4：變性人
9：不詳或在病歷上未記載。
fields.description_en: 1: Male 2: Female 3: Other (e.g., hermaphrodite) 4: Transgender 9: Unknown or not recorded in the medical history.

fields.description_zh:
個案診斷為癌症時之戶籍地代碼。
9999：戶籍地不詳
詳欄位(變項)譯碼(一)【戶籍地代碼(RESIDCD)對照表】
fields.description_en: Household registration location code at the time the case was diagnosed with cancer. 9999: household registration location unknown. See field (variable) coding (1) [Household Registration Location Code (RESIDCD) table].

fields.description_zh:

001：1歲，但是小於2歲
002：2歲
…：填入診斷年齡
120：120歲
999：診斷年齡不詳。
fields.description_en: Record the actual age of diagnosis for this cancer. 000: Less than 1 year old 001: 1 year old but less than 2 years old 002: 2 years old … Fill in the diagnosed age 120: 120 years old 999: Age at diagnosis not specified.

fields.description_zh:
詳欄位(變項)譯碼(二)【個案分類
(CLASS)對照表】
fields.description_en: See field (variable) coding explanation (2) [Case Classification (CLASS) Table].

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案至申報醫院首次為此癌症就診時的癌症診療情境，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(二)【個案分類(CLASS)對照表
(1) 診斷狀態分類(CLASS_D)對照表】。
fields.description_en: Record the cancer treatment scenario at the first visit to the reporting hospital for this cancer case, detailed field (item) coding (II) [Case classification(CLASS) lookup table (1) Diagnosis status classification(CLASS_D) lookup table].

fields.description_zh:
記錄此個案在申報時的治療狀態，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(二)【個案分類
(CLASS)對照表(2) 治療狀態分類(CLASS_T)對照表】。
fields.description_en: Record the treatment status of this case at the time of claim, detailed field (variable) code (II) 【Case classification (CLASS) reference table (2) Treatment status classification (CLASS_T) reference table】.

fields.description_zh:
YYYYMMDD：個案因此癌症至申報醫院門診或住院之最早日期。
99999999：個案首次到申報醫院就診日期不詳
年不詳：9999 月不詳：99 日不詳：99。
fields.description_en: YYYYMMDD：the earliest date of the patient's visit to a clinic or hospital due to cancer for the first time. 99999999：patient's first visit date to the reporting hospital is unknown. Year unknown: 9999 Month unknown: 99 Day unknown: 99.

fields.description_zh:
YYYYMMDD：最初診斷日期是指此癌症最早被醫師診斷的日期。
99999999：最初診斷日期不詳
年不詳：9999
月不詳：99
日不詳：99。
fields.description_en: YYYYMMDD：Initial diagnosis date refers to the earliest date when a physician diagnosed this cancer. 99999999：Initial diagnosis date unknown Year unknown: 9999 Month unknown: 99 Day unknown: 99.

fields.description_zh:
依ICD-O-3腫瘤部位碼 (topography code)進行原發部位編碼。
NHL(非何杰金氏淋巴瘤)、HL(何杰金氏淋巴瘤)及LEU(白血病)等血液腫瘤個案，在此欄位無法辨識，請用組織類型與性態碼(HISTBEH)區分。若是要分析各癌症部分(CASITE欄
位)，也請先把NHL、HL、LEU等血液腫瘤排除後再計算。
fields.description_en: Topography code (ICD-O-3) is used for primary site coding. Cases of NHL (non-Hodgkin lymphoma), HL (Hodgkin lymphoma), and LEU (leukemia) cannot be identified in this field; please use histological type and behavior code (HISTBEH) to distinguish. If analyzing cancer sites (CASITE field), please exclude NHL, HL, and LEU cases first.

fields.description_zh:
0：非成對器官
1：原發起源位在右側
2：原發起源位在左側
3：只有單側侵犯，但起源於左側或右側則不清楚
4：雙側侵犯但起源之側位不清楚，且病歷描述是單一原發(較少見) 。․雙側卵巢同時有單一組織類型之腫瘤侵犯。
․雙側同時有視網膜芽細胞瘤(retinoblastomas)。
․雙側同時有Wilm 腫瘤(Wilm tumors)。
5：成對器官，位於身體中線的腫瘤。
9：成對器官，但其側位不清楚。
fields.description_en: 0: non-paired organs 1: primary origin on the right side 2: primary origin on the left side 3: unilateral invasion but unclear whether it originated from the left or right side 4: bilateral invasion but unclear which side it originated from, and the medical record describes a single primary (rare) . ... both ovaries are simultaneously invaded by tumors of a single tissue type. ... retinoblastomas in both sides. ... Wilm's tumors in both sides. 5: paired organs with a tumor located on the midline of the body. 9: paired organs but unclear which side it is.

fields.description_zh:
依據國際疾病分類腫瘤學第三版(ICD-O-3)的分類標準，填寫原發的腫瘤部位的組織病理形態，表示方式為8000-9993。(組織病理碼(M-code)第一字母M 不填入)
詳組織類型與性態碼(HISTBEH)對照表
(血液腫瘤編碼範圍：9590-9993，需排除9990。血液腫瘤細分類詳血液腫瘤分類表)
fields.description_en: According to the classification standard of International Classification of Diseases for Oncology Third Edition (ICD-O-3), fill in the primary tumor site's histological morphology, represented as 8000-9993. (Do not include the first letter M in the M-code) Detailed tissue type and behavior code (HISTBEH) reference table (Blood tumor coding range: 9590-9993, excluding 9990).

fields.description_zh: 記錄病理診斷中的性態碼。M-code中的第 5 碼即為性態碼，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(三)【性態碼(BEHAVIOR)對照表】。
fields.description_en: Record the nature code in pathological diagnosis. The fifth digit of M-code is the nature code, detailed in field (variable) code (three) [Nature Code (BEHAVIOR) Reference Table].

fields.description_en: Cancer confirmation method reference table (CONFIRM) code (4)

fields.name_zh: 首次顯微鏡檢證實日期
fields.description_zh:
YYYYMMDD：指此癌症最早顯微鏡檢證實的日期。
00000000：個案未做顯微鏡檢檢查
99999999：不清楚個案是否有接受顯微鏡檢檢查、「首次顯微鏡檢證實日期」期不詳。
年不詳：9999 月不詳：99 日不詳：99。
fields.description_en: YYYYMMDD: refers to the date when this cancer was first confirmed under microscopic examination. 00000000: patient did not undergo microscopic examination 99999999: unclear whether the patient underwent microscopic examination or 'first microscopic confirmation date' is unknown. Year unknown: 9999; Month unknown: 99; Day unknown: 99

fields.description_zh:
YYYYMMDD：記錄個案在申報醫院最早針對癌症進行手術的日期。
00000000：沒有進行任何手術、於屍體解剖時才診斷為癌症
99999999：不知道個案是否有接受手術治療、個案有接受手術治療但是接受手術治療的日期不清楚、僅由死亡證明書得知個案有癌症。年不詳：9999月不詳：99 日不詳：99。
fields.description_en: YYYYMMDD：The earliest date of inpatient surgery for cancer at the reporting hospital. 00000000：No surgery performed, diagnosed with cancer only during autopsy. 99999999：Unclear if surgery was performed, surgery date unknown, or only known from death certificate. Year: 9999 Month: 99 Day: 99.

fields.name_zh: 申報醫院原發部位手術方式
fields.description_zh: 記錄在申報醫院對原發部位所進行的手術方式，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(五)【申報醫院原發部位手術方式(OPTYPE)對照表】。
fields.description_en: Records the surgical method performed on the primary site at the reporting hospital; see field (variable) coding (5) [Reporting hospital primary site surgical method (OPTYPE) lookup table].

fields.description_zh: 記錄在申報醫院的首次療程中，進行放射治療的開始日期，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(六)【放射治療開始日期(RT_DT)對照表】。
fields.description_en: Records the start date of radiotherapy during the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital; see field (variable) code table (6) [Radiotherapy start date (RT_DT) lookup table].

fields.description_zh: 詳欄位(變項)譯碼(七)【放射治療機構(RT)對照表】。
fields.description_en: See field (variable) coding (7) [Radiotherapy institution (RT) cross-reference table].

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案於申報醫院首次療程中，所給予化學治療相關情形，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(八)【申報醫院化學治療
(CHEM)對照表】。
fields.description_en: Records the chemotherapy given to the case during the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital; see field (variable) coding explanation (8) [Reporting Hospital Chemotherapy (CHEM) Table].

fields.name_zh: 申報醫院化學治療開始日期
fields.description_zh: 詳欄位(變項)譯碼(九)【申報醫院化學治療開始日期(CHEM_DT)對照表】。
fields.description_en: See field (variable) coding explanation (9) [Reporting hospital chemotherapy start date (CHEM_DT) reference table].

fields.name_zh: 申報醫院荷爾蒙/類固醇治療
fields.description_zh: 記載個案在申報醫院首次療程中，所給予荷爾蒙治療的相關情形，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(十)【申報醫院荷爾蒙治療(HORM)對照表】。
fields.name_zh_en: hospital report of hormone / corticosteroid treatment
fields.description_en: Records hormone therapy given to the case during the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital; see field (variable) coding (10) [Reporting Hospital Hormone Therapy (HORM) table].

fields.name_zh: 申報醫院荷爾蒙/類固醇治療開始日期

fields.name_zh_en: Reported hospital hormone / steroid therapy start date
fields.description_en: Detailed Field (Variable) Code (XI) [Reported Hospital Hormone Dependent Treatment Start Date (HORM_DT) Lookup Table]

fields.description_zh:
記載申報醫院於首次療程中，所給予免疫治療的相關情形，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(十二)【申報醫院免疫治療
(IMMU)對照表】。
fields.description_en: Records details of immunotherapy given during the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital; see field (variable) coding (12) [Reporting hospital immunotherapy (IMMU) lookup table].

fields.name_zh: 申報醫院免疫治療開始日期
fields.description_zh:
詳欄位(變項)譯碼(十三)【申報醫院免疫治療開始日期(IMMU_DT)對照
表】。
fields.description_en: See field (variable) coding explanation (13) [Immunotherapy start date at reporting hospital (IMMU_DT) correspondence table].

fields.name_zh: 申報醫院骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置
fields.description_zh:
記錄個案在申報醫院首次治療時，給予骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌治療情形，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(十四)【申報醫院骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置
(BMTYPE)對照表】。
fields.name_zh_en: Claimed hospital bone marrow/cord blood transplantation or endocrine management.
fields.description_en: Records whether bone marrow/stem cell transplantation or endocrine therapy was given during the case's first treatment at the reporting hospital; see field (variable) coding (14) [Reporting hospital bone marrow/stem cell transplantation or endocrine procedure (BMTYPE) cross-reference table].

fields.name_zh: 申報醫院骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置開始日期
fields.description_zh: 詳欄位(變項)譯碼(十五)【申報醫院骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置開始日期(BM_DT)對照表】。
fields.name_zh_en: Date of bone marrow/stem cell transplantation or endocrine management initiation at the reporting hospital.
fields.description_en: See field (variable) coding explanation (15) [Reporting Hospital Bone Marrow/Stem Cell Transplantation or Endocrine Procedure Start Date (BM_DT) Table].

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案在申報醫院首次治療時，給予標靶治療情形，詳欄位(變項)譯碼
(十六)【申報醫院標靶治療(TARGET)對照表】。
fields.description_en:
Records the targeted therapy given at the reporting hospital during the case's first treatment; see field (variable) code
table (16) [Reporting-hospital targeted therapy (TARGET) lookup table].

fields.name_zh: 申報醫院標靶治療開始日期
fields.description_zh: 詳欄位(變項)譯碼(十七)【申報醫院標靶治療開始日期(TARGET_DT)對照表】。
fields.description_en: See field (variable) coding explanation (17) [Reporting hospital targeted therapy start date (TARGET_DT) reference table].

fields.description_zh: 申報醫院為緩解或減輕個案症狀所提供之照護，包括手術治療、放射治療、全身性治療(化學治療、荷爾蒙治療或其他全身性藥物)及疼痛控制治療，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(十八)【申報醫院緩和照護(PALLIATE)對照表】。
fields.description_en: Care provided by the reporting hospital to relieve or alleviate the case's symptoms, including surgical treatment, radiotherapy, systemic therapy (chemotherapy, hormone therapy, or other systemic drugs), and pain control treatment; see field (variable) coding (18) [Reporting Hospital Palliative Care (PALLIATE) table].

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案於首次治療前的身高。
000-099：<100cm 之身高數值(採四捨五入)。
100-998：≧100cm 之身高數值(採四捨五入)。
999：病歷未記載或不詳。
fields.description_en: Record the height of the case before the first treatment. 000-099: <100cm height value(rounded). 100-998: ≧100cm height value(rounded). 999: Medical record not recorded or unclear.

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案於首次治療前的體重。
記錄個案於首次治療前的身高。
000-099：<100kg之身高數值(採四捨五入)。
100-998：≧100kg之身高數值(採四捨五入)。
999：病歷未記載或不詳。
fields.description_en: Record the patient's weight before the first treatment. Record the patient's height before the first treatment. 000-099: <100kg height value (rounded to nearest). 100-998: ≥100kg height value (rounded to nearest). 999: Medical record not documented or unclear.

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案於最初診斷日前的吸菸行為。
1-2碼為每日吸菸量(以支為單位)
․ 00：無吸菸。
․ 10：每日10支(半包)
․ 20：每日20支(1包)
․ 90：每日≧90支(≧4.5包)
․ 91：偶爾吸(無規律或無定量)
․ 98：有吸，但量不詳
․ 99：病歷未記載或吸菸狀態完全不詳者3-4碼為吸菸年
․ 00：無吸菸。
․ 05：吸菸5年。
․ 15：每日20支(1包)
․ 98：每日≧90支(≧4.5包)
․ 99：病歷未記載或吸菸狀態完全不詳者
5-6碼為戒菸年
․ 00：無戒吸菸。
․ 05：已戒 5年。
․ 15：已戒15年
․ 88：無吸菸
․ 98：已戒，但年不詳
․ 99：病歷未記載或戒菸狀態完全不詳者
fields.description_en:
Records smoking behavior before the date of initial diagnosis.
Digits 1-2: cigarettes smoked per day (in cigarettes)
․ 00: Non-smoker.
․ 10: 10 per day (half pack)
․ 20: 20 per day (1 pack)
․ 90: ≧90 per day (≧4.5 packs)
․ 91: Occasional smoking (irregular or unquantified)
․ 98: Smokes, amount unknown
․ 99: Not recorded in medical record or smoking status completely unknown. Digits 3-4: years smoked
․ 00: Non-smoker.
․ 05: Smoked 5 years.
․ 15: 20 per day (1 pack)
․ 98: ≧90 per day (≧4.5 packs)
․ 99: Not recorded in medical record or smoking status completely unknown
Digits 5-6: years since quitting
․ 00: Has not quit smoking.
․ 05: Quit 5 years ago.
․ 15: Quit 15 years ago
․ 88: Non-smoker
․ 98: Quit, years unknown
․ 99: Not recorded in medical record or quitting status completely unknown

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案於最初診斷日前的嚼檳榔行為。
1-2碼為每日嚼檳榔量，以”顆”計算․ 00：無嚼檳榔。
․ 10：每日10顆
․ 20：每日20顆
․ 90：每日≧90顆
․ 91：偶爾嚼(無規律或無定量)
․ 98：有嚼，但量不詳
․ 99：病歷未記載或嚼檳榔狀態完全不詳者
3-4碼為嚼檳榔年
․ 00：無嚼檳榔
․ 05：嚼5年
․ 15：嚼15年
․ 98：嚼檳榔，但年不詳
․ 99：病歷未記載或嚼檳榔狀態完全不詳者
5-6碼為戒檳榔年

name_zh_from_listing: Health15_癌症登記檔短表SF(2011-2017年版本)(20250624起適用)
data_description_en: Includes original data of diagnosed cases reported by each hospital from 2011 to 2017.
notes_en:
1. ※ This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address were deleted, and fields such as
national ID number, facility code, insured unit code, unified business number, date of birth, date of visit and admission date are
masked. The data may be used only in the independent work area set up by this Ministry, and only statistical results
that pass review may be taken out, to ensure that the use and disclosure of the data cannot identify any specific individual.
2. Contains the raw data reported by hospitals for cases diagnosed in 2011-2017 and later; duplicate cases (the
same case with the same cancer and the same histology group across hospitals) have not been removed.
3. The cancers covered by the cancer registry short form (ROC year 100 (2011) edition) include all cancers reported by short-form hospitals
as well as all other cancer types outside those reported by long-form hospitals, all of which are reported on the short form.
4. For cases with case classification 0 or 3, field serial numbers 7.1-7.5 need not be reported; fill with 9.
5. To analyze data from diagnosis year 1979 to the latest published year with
inter-hospital duplicates removed (annual-report linked data), please apply for the annual-report linked file.
